title: Metal: Crash when rendering a Light2D with shadows enabled
body:
- *Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/117372.*

### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.dev1, 4.7.dev https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/4a280218fcfdd69408cceb74577c9e69086be23a
- Not reproducible in: 4.6.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (4a280218f) - macOS Tahoe (26.1.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory

I bisected the regression to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114484. cc @stuartcarnie

The crash affects both Forward+ and Mobile. The crash doesn't occur in OpenGL or Vulkan.

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a Sprite2D node a with a texutre (so the light can be seen in action).
- Add a PointLight2D node with a texture. Enable shadows on it. The crash occurs as soon as you enable shadows.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_light2d_crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26151806/test_light2d_crash.zip)
